verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Tzach k'eta t'a lum witz b'aj ayinek' tik yet' winhaj Aarón, winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú yet' pax 70-ok heb' yichamtak winakil he chonhab'. Ha heb' chi' najatto skan heb' yak'em sb'a t'ayin.
Ha achxonhej syal a k'eul t'a in tz'ey, haxo pax heb' winh chi', max yal-laj sk'eta heb' winh yet' pax heb' chonhab' max yal-laj sk'eta heb' et'ok, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix emixta winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima tas leyal ix yak' Jehová yet' tas ix yutej yalani. Axo masanil heb' anima chi', junnhej ix aj stak'wi heb'. --Masanil tas ix yal Jehová chi', ol ko k'anab'ajej, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix stz'ib'an winhaj Moisés masanil tas ix yal Jehová. Axo ix sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix k'e waan winh, ix sb'oan jun altar winh t'a yich witz chi', ix yak'ank'e linhan lajchawe' k'een k'een winh. Ha junjun k'een k'een chi', junjun makan yinhtilal Israel sch'ox k'een.

T'a elanhchamel ix schekan juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak winak winhaj Moisés chi' yik smilan nok' toro heb' silab'ok yik stz'a t'a smasanil yet' juntzanhxo silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Jehová.
Axo winhaj Moisés chi' ix chaan nanhal schiq'uil nok', ix yak'anem winh t'a yol juntzanh yet'tal, haxo nanhalxo, ix stzikanoch winh t'a altar chi'.

Ix yik'ank'e winh b'aj tz'ib'ab'il strato Dios, ix yawtan winh t'a skal heb' chonhab'. Ixlajwi yawtan winh, ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Masanil tas syal Jehová, ol ko k'anab'ajej, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot schiq'uil nok' winh, haton ix yak'kanem winh t'a yol juntzanh yet'tal chi', ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh heb' anima chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha jun chik' tik sch'oxani to tz'ochkan yopisio jun strato Jehová ix sb'o ket'ok tik, haton masanil tas ix yal t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ex winh t'a lum witzal Sinaí chi'. Ajun winhaj Aarón, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú yet' pax 70 heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix k'e yet' winh.
Ata' ix yil sDiosal heb' winh. Ha t'a yalanh yok, toxonhej skopopi icha k'een zafiro te wach' yilji, icha syaxil satcha'anh.
Malaj tas ix utaj heb' winh yuj yipalil Dios. Ix yil Dios heb' winh, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh t'a yichanh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Q'ueanhkot t'a jolom witz b'aj ayinek' tik, tza tanhwan ta', ata' ol wak' chab' k'een k'een t'ayach, haton k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch juntzanh cheknab'il wuuj, yik tz'och he k'ayb'ub'alok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix k'e winhaj Moisés t'a lum witz chi' yet' winhaj Josué winh skolwaj yet' winh.

Ayik manto b'atlaj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi': --Kananhek t'a tik masanto ol onh emxulok. Ayek' winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Hur eyet'ok. Tato ay tas he gana sb'oi, a heb' winh tik ol b'oan t'ayex, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e heb' winh schawanhil. T'a elanhchamel ix och moynaj jun asun t'a lum witz chi'.
Axo stzikikial Jehová ix jawi t'a yib'anh lum witzal Sinaí chi', wake' wal k'ual ix och oyan asun t'a lu'um. Axo t'a yukil k'ual ix awtajk'e winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová t'a skal asun chi'.
Ix sch'ox sb'a stzikikial Jehová t'a skal jun asun t'a lum witz chi', t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Ha stzikikial chi', lajan yilji icha junok k'ak' te ow stz'ab'at smasanil yuj.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Moisés t'a skal jun asun chi'. Ix k'e winh t'a slajwub'alxo sjolom lum witz chi'. 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal ix kan winh ta'.
